mapper.select: select sku.id from wms_item_sku sku inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id = item.id where sku.sku_name like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or sku.sku_code like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or sku.barcode like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or item.item_name like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or item.item_code like concat('%', #{word}, '%')

select sku.id as sku_id, sku.*, item.id as item_id, item.*, loc.id as location_id, loc.location_name, loc.location_code from wms_item_sku sku inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id left join wms_location loc on sku.item_location_id = loc.id where sku.id in
#{id}

select sku.id as sku_id, sku.*, item.id as item_id, item.*, loc.id as location_id, loc.location_name, loc.location_code from wms_item_sku sku inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id left join wms_location loc on sku.item_location_id = loc.id where sku.id = #{id}

select sku.id as sku_id, sku.*, item.id as item_id, item.*, loc.id as location_id, loc.location_name, loc.location_code from wms_item_sku sku inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id=item.id inner join wms_item_category category on item.item_category=category.id left join wms_location loc on sku.item_location_id = loc.id
and item.item_name like concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
and item.item_code like concat('%', #{bo.itemCode}, '%')
and item.item_brand=#{bo.itemBrand}
and sku.sku_name like concat('%', #{bo.skuName}, '%')
and sku.barcode like concat('%', #{bo.barcode}, '%')
and (category.id=#{bo.itemCategory} or category.parent_id=#{bo.itemCategory})
and loc.id = #{bo.itemLocationId}
and exists ( select 1 from wms_item_tag_rel rel where rel.item_id = item.id and rel.tag_id = #{bo.tagId} )
and (
item.item_name like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or item.item_code like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or sku.sku_name like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or sku.sku_code like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or sku.barcode like concat('%', #{word}, '%') or loc.location_code like concat('%', #{word}, '%')
)
order by sku.item_id desc
